comment: Supply-chain pin for the recognition engine and the model. Every entry here is fixed: the release workflow verifies what it downloads or clones against these values and refuses to publish on a mismatch. There is no override. The application itself never downloads anything.

whisper_cpp.comment: The clone is checked against this commit before anything is compiled, so a moved tag cannot change what ships.

models.rationale: Preliminary choice, not yet benchmarked on Windows: the smallest Whisper size that still looked usable for Russian scientific dictation in text-level checks, at a download of about 181 MiB. Whether it runs near real time on a mid-range Windows laptop CPU without a discrete GPU is an open question until the measurement in docs/development/RELEASE_CHECKLIST.md is done.

notes: source_url points at an immutable Hugging Face revision, not at a branch: resolve/main would let the file change under a fixed digest reference.
A second, lighter model may be added here once its digest and size have been pinned the same way. An entry without them is not shippable and the workflow will refuse it.

To add or move a pin: download the file once on a trusted machine, run `shasum -a 256 <file>` (or `certutil -hashfile <file> SHA256`), and paste the digest and the byte size here in the same commit that changes source_url.
